title: The DVFS loop and its leakage · ET-SoC-1
description: David Kanter described how a mature chip regulates its own power: an activity-based estimator inside a DVFS loop, and cache arrays behind leakage-suppression transistors. Checked against the ET-SoC-1's firmware source, its open RTL and two cards: the loop reads a power meter rather than estimating power and, with no dead band, hunts at its 65 °C threshold on aifoundry2; the open RTL has per-minion sleep controls, tied off, and the card shows no array power gating; on aifoundry2 at 80 °C leakage is 55–80% of an idle card and 31–45% of a busy one, against his 5–30%; and aifoundry3's firmware TDP of 0 W pins it at 600 MHz.
